requirements.requirement: House rules: cap open faces and lock joints (parts settled, not a smallest-build brief)
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 18 end caps and lockJoints added 12 joint bolts; single connected group in check_build.

finish.summary: A 7-cell hex-flower organizer: seven full bases each holding a full-depth bin (three plain, two 2-compartment, two 3-compartment — well over six separate storage spots), capped and joint-bolted, and staged with heaps of M3 screws, nuts and standoffs plus electrical tape so each bin's small-parts purpose reads from above. Verified clear by check_build.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
